answer: Each agent locks a refundable deposit behind a registered key, one key to one bond, so a thousand fake agents mean a thousand real deposits — slashed the moment two keys share an operator. The bond is a jetty that turns every wave aside, but a sybil farm must build it a thousand times. Withdrawals pass a cooldown, so stake cannot cycle between identities, and each slashing raises the price of the next forgery. A garden of cheap aliases becomes a ledger of forfeited capital: the mechanism never proves who an agent is, it prices multiplicity, leaving the mesa of stake out of reach.
